name: Grembo Gribbles
description: Grembo Gribbles is a small gnome plumber dressed in thick, waterproof overalls and equipped with a long, slender metal rod used for sounding floors and pipes. He possesses a magnificent, twitching nose capable of sniffing out plumbing miasmas and neglect. He services establishments like Trollskull Manor under guild contracts connected to the Cromers, uncovering hidden structural and sewer access issues.
ideals: Craftsmanship: 'Proper pipes and clean lines keep a building standing and sweet-smelling.'
Duty: 'When the plumbing fails, you trace the miasma to its true source.'
bonds: The plumbing and sanitation guilds of Waterdeep.
Patrons like the Cromers whose supply lines and properties he services.
flaws: Can be overly focused on pipe networks and smells, occasionally missing broader dangers until they are directly uncovered.
speech_patterns: Chatty, energetic, and professional, often commenting on smells, sounds, and fluid dynamics with cheerful expertise.
mannerisms: Twitches his large nose to test air quality, taps floors and walls with a long sounding rod (*tink, tink, tink... thunk*), and inspects dark cellar access points with cautious curiosity.
motivations: To clear blocked lines, install iron grates, and sanitize compromised cellars.
To earn an honest wage working guild contracts across the city.
knowledge: Expertise in plumbing, drainage networks, and sewer access points beneath Waterdeep.
Familiarity with guild pricing, repairs, and structural pipe layouts in old manors.
gm_notes: Grembo Gribbles serves as a functional and quirky local tradesman who can introduce players to hidden basement access doors, sewer connections, and plumbing infrastructure issues beneath properties like Trollskull Manor.
